identity.name: San Souci Estates
identity.notes: Historic residential enclave in the Norland district of North Miami, known for its older (mostly mid-20th-century) single-family homes on quiet, tree-lined streets. The name is French for "sans souci" (without worry). The community is entered through a controlled gate on San Souci Road.

fees.note: Some lots pay a community-association/common-area charge (gate operation, street/common-area upkeep), but no reliable published figure is available. Confirm current dues directly with the San Souci community association or a listing agent before purchase. No CDD special assessment is known to apply to this older neighborhood.
Monthly HOA figure not reliably documented in public sources; treat as unknown rather than quoting a number.

amenities.detail: Single controlled entry gate with guard/entry monitoring at the main entrance along San Souci Road; otherwise a residential street-based neighborhood rather than a planned CDD, so there is no known clubhouse, pool, or golf facility within the community itself.

proximity.nearest_name: Miami-Dade Public Library - North Miami Branch (11701 NW 20th St)
